name: Digital Sovereignty Lens
description: AWS Well-Architected Digital Sovereignty Lens providing guidance on digital sovereignty requirements including compliance, control, and continuity for cloud workloads.

questions.title: How does your organization address compliance requirements?
questions.description: Compliance is a shared responsibility requiring collaboration among specialized teams and delegation at an organization level. Security consultants establish policies, DevSecOps teams develop reusable controls, and developers deploy controls to meet workload-specific requirements.

helpfulResource.displayText: Organizations operating in the cloud need an effective compliance function to meet regulatory requirements, protect data, and maintain stakeholder trust. This involves establishing governance structures, conducting compliance requirements analysis, integrating compliance tooling, and implementing continuous improvements.

improvementPlan.displayText: Establish a compliance function with executive sponsorship and cross-functional expertise. Document core compliance processes, define roles, create RACI matrix, develop policies aligned with business objectives, and set up audit support processes.

helpfulResource.displayText: Effective compliance at scale requires distributing responsibilities across teams while maintaining centralized oversight and standards. By delegating compliance responsibilities while providing common guardrails and automated tools, organizations achieve both compliance consistency and operational agility.

improvementPlan.displayText: Deploy foundational compliance tools, define roles and responsibilities, establish guardrails using SCPs, RCPs, and CloudFormation guard rules, delegate responsibilities through IAM policies and permission boundaries, and train teams on compliance processes.

helpfulResource.displayText: Compliance-trained software professionals can design and build systems that adhere to regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS. Without awareness, technical decisions can lead to vulnerabilities or non-compliant solutions.

improvementPlan.displayText: Develop structured, role-specific training programs combining foundational training with hands-on practice. Assess learning needs, define success criteria, create role-specific content, deliver through interactive modules and workshops, and track effectiveness.

helpfulResource.displayText: Vendor compliance management is essential for maintaining security and regulatory adherence across your supply chain. Partners must meet the same cybersecurity standards, data privacy requirements, and industry-specific regulations for effective risk mitigation.

improvementPlan.displayText: Create vendor inventory, design assessment frameworks with tiered questionnaires, implement assessment processes, build contractual protections, deploy continuous monitoring for third-party integrations, and establish governance structures.

questions.title: How do you design workloads for compliance?
questions.description: Designing compliant workloads is critical for AWS customers in an era of increasingly complex and stringent regulatory landscapes. Non-compliance can lead to severe financial penalties, legal repercussions, and reputational damage.

helpfulResource.displayText: Baselining compliance requirements is crucial for maintaining a consistent and secure posture. It assists in proactively identifying gaps, reducing risks, and maintaining adherence to regulatory standards.

improvementPlan.displayText: Define a compliance matrix mapping regulatory requirements to technical controls. Document jurisdiction-specific requirements, build a comprehensive knowledge base, conduct gap analysis, log and manage risks, and review compliance baselines periodically.

choices.title: Establish an automated path to compliance

helpfulResource.displayText: Establish an automated path to effectively meet cybersecurity standards, data privacy legislation, and industry-specific regulations. Automation reduces human error, speeds up compliance processes, and allows for continuous monitoring.

improvementPlan.displayText: Codify compliance requirements into compliance as code policies. Integrate validation into CI/CD pipelines using the three lines of defense model. Implement risk management, risk oversight, and risk assessment with automated controls and remediations.

choices.title: Develop and track key compliance metrics

helpfulResource.displayText: In highly regulated industries, developing and tracking compliance metrics is critical for demonstrating adherence to required standards. Teams use automated compliance metrics to reduce risk, accelerate remediation, and improve regulatory posture.

improvementPlan.displayText: Identify operational and business metrics categorized by AWS account, Region, resource type, severity, and security standards. Enable AWS Security Hub CSPM, set up operational metrics, and monitor and optimize compliance tracking.

questions.title: How do you design your workload for continuous auditability?
questions.description: In highly regulated industries, continuous auditability enables real-time compliance visibility, reduces risk of breaches or non-compliance penalties, and builds trust with regulators. It shifts compliance from a reactive, manual process to an automated, proactive practice.

helpfulResource.displayText: For customers in highly regulated industries, proactive audit planning assists organizations as they strive to meet their audit obligations with greater certainty and regularity.

improvementPlan.displayText: Conduct readiness assessments with regular internal audits. Establish audit governance processes, prepare audit artifacts including policies and documentation, and pre-provision audit tools like AWS Audit Manager with read-only auditor roles.

helpfulResource.displayText: Manual evidence collection is time-consuming, error-prone, and may not provide a comprehensive view of your AWS environment. Automating these processes improves accuracy, efficiency, and audit readiness.

improvementPlan.displayText: Design audit-ready applications using a source, analyze, visualize, evidence (SAVE) paradigm. Collect logs from multiple sources, aggregate findings, use built-in analytics, create visualizations, and leverage AWS Audit Manager for automated evidence collection.

questions.title: How do you monitor your current compliance status?
questions.description: Monitoring compliance status enables organizations to proactively identify and address potential compliance gaps before they become significant issues. Continuous monitoring helps detect unauthorized changes and verify security controls remain effective.

choices.title: Maintain continuous visibility of your compliance status

helpfulResource.displayText: Proactive monitoring reduces risks of data breaches, misconfigurations, and audit failures by providing visibility into resource configurations and user activity.

improvementPlan.displayText: Enable logging and monitoring services, define compliance baselines. Collect logs using CloudTrail, aggregate at central location, collect and aggregate findings using Control Tower and Security Hub, analyze findings, and set up metrics, alarms, and notifications.

choices.title: Correlate security findings to compliance requirements

helpfulResource.displayText: Map and aggregate findings to avoid duplication and reduce information overload. Findings correlated to regulatory requirements enable stakeholders to quickly identify compliance gaps and prioritize remediation efforts.

improvementPlan.displayText: Enable AWS Control Tower controls, activate AWS Security Hub CSPM with compliance standards, deploy AWS Audit Manager to map findings to regulatory requirements, and enrich Security Hub findings with additional compliance context.

questions.title: How do you remediate non-compliance?
questions.description: Automate compliance remediation to maintain continuous regulatory alignment. Detect and correct violations as they occur instead of relying on manual intervention. This approach reduces operational overhead, minimizes human error, and improves audit readiness.

choices.title: Enable independent root cause analysis and remediation

helpfulResource.displayText: Provide engineering teams with the tools, knowledge, and permissions necessary to independently identify, analyze, and resolve compliance violations. Self-service capabilities reduce dependency on centralized security teams while accelerating remediation.

improvementPlan.displayText: Identify and collect compliance data with scoped access and cross-service correlation. Integrate with AWS Security Hub and EventBridge, perform root cause analysis using Five Whys or Ishikawa techniques, and implement remediation with verification and documentation.

helpfulResource.displayText: Implement automated remediation to detect and correct compliance violations with minimal human intervention. Automation provides consistent, rapid response to known compliance issues while maintaining proper oversight and audit trails.

improvementPlan.displayText: Setup AWS Systems Manager Automation with conformance packs including remediations. Build customized remediation workflows for staging and approvals, create custom runbooks, and trigger remediation from Security Hub findings using EventBridge.

choices.title: Track regulatory changes across operating Regions

helpfulResource.displayText: Track, analyze, and adapt to regulatory changes across jurisdictions to maintain adherence and reduce risk. A resilient, compliance-aligned program proactively identifies, assesses, and implements regulatory changes.

improvementPlan.displayText: Establish a regulatory intelligence function with multi-disciplinary experts. Partner with local legal experts, work with regulatory authorities, use AWS services and Marketplace GRC offerings, implement GRC software, update training, and establish regular review cycles.

helpfulResource.displayText: Regulatory changes directly impact cloud operations, security controls, and compliance status. A structured change management process helps identify, assess, and implement regulatory requirements efficiently while avoiding compliance gaps.

improvementPlan.displayText: Create a regulatory change management function with defined roles and processes. Conduct detailed impact analysis, use AWS resource tagging to track affected resources, evaluate technical and operational measures, and implement systematic change management.

questions.title: How do you record and control access to data?
questions.description: Recording and controlling access to data is essential for meeting key requirements of regulations like GDPR and HIPAA, which mandate strict oversight of who can access sensitive personal and healthcare information.

choices.title: Establish comprehensive logging and monitoring of user actions

helpfulResource.displayText: Comprehensive logging enables organizations to track user activities, detect unauthorized access, and provide evidence during security incidents or audits. This is a key capability required by sovereign workloads.

improvementPlan.displayText: Define logging requirements and retention periods, configure AWS CloudTrail across accounts and Regions, enable service-specific logging, establish centralized log storage with sovereignty controls, implement log analysis and monitoring, and validate third-party controls.

helpfulResource.displayText: Data access controls are fundamental to digital sovereignty, verifying that only authorized users and services can access data in adherence to regulatory requirements.

improvementPlan.displayText: Build a data perimeter with trusted identities, resources, and networks. Use global condition keys to restrict access, apply resource-based policies, implement network-level controls with VPC architecture and PrivateLink, implement data protection controls with encryption, and set up logging and monitoring.

questions.title: How do you prove the effectiveness of your data access policies in blocking unintended information exposure?
questions.description: Measuring the effectiveness of data access policies is critical to verify they are actually blocking unauthorized data exposure rather than just appearing compliant on paper. Continuous monitoring and regular assessment validate controls are working as intended.

choices.title: Validate policy effectiveness through automated analysis

helpfulResource.displayText: Manual policy validation is error-prone and does not scale. Automated reasoning tools mathematically analyze access policies to identify potential security gaps, overprivileged access, and unintended permissions before they are exploited.

improvementPlan.displayText: Enable AWS IAM Access Analyzer to identify resources shared with external entities. Integrate with CI/CD pipelines using Access Analyzer APIs. Implement custom policy checks and integrate AWS CloudFormation Guard rules for policy adherence validation.

choices.title: Verify network security posture through automated analysis

helpfulResource.displayText: Automated network analysis tools provide mathematical proof of network configurations. This enables verification of adherence to data residency and privacy requirements.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use VPC Network Access Analyzer to validate blocked traffic between sources and destinations. Use VPC Reachability Analyzer to verify intended connectivity. Define network access scopes aligned with data residency requirements and establish continuous monitoring.

questions.title: How do you enhance threat detection capabilities for regulated workloads using intelligence and telemetry?
questions.description: Organizations in highly regulated industries need strong threat detection capabilities to meet stringent monitoring and reporting requirements. Implementing relevant cyber threat intelligence and continuously validating detection coverage improves both regulatory adherence and operational performance.

choices.title: Enhance threat detection through targeted intelligence

helpfulResource.displayText: By using region and domain-specific threat intelligence, organizations can enhance their detection capabilities. This targeted approach allows security teams to contextualize threats within their specific regulatory and infrastructure environment.

improvementPlan.displayText: Review threat intelligence guidelines in applicable compliance frameworks. Select CTI sources and services including Amazon GuardDuty. Integrate and operationalize CTI capabilities across intelligence management, technology integration, and quality assurance.

choices.title: Detect threats through comprehensive telemetry and analysis

helpfulResource.displayText: Effective threat detection capability needs comprehensive telemetry from multiple sources, the ability to correlate and contextualize data points, and centralized visibility of security events.

improvementPlan.displayText: Map compliance requirements to threat detection capabilities. Review telemetry coverage including UEBA, DLP, and SIEM. Deploy automation for data collection and analytics using AI/ML. Perform regular reviews of detection capabilities and conduct threat modeling.

questions.title: How do you secure infrastructure access while enabling regional operations?
questions.description: Access to data and environments must be limited to locations that are trusted and meet local jurisdictional requirements. Organizations must implement comprehensive access controls, continuous monitoring, and role-based access aligned with jurisdictional boundaries.

choices.title: Control unauthorized remote access to infrastructure

helpfulResource.displayText: Implement access controls to ensure only authorized support staff from verified locations can access infrastructure resources. This includes identity verification, location validation, and continuous monitoring of access activities.

improvementPlan.displayText: Implement strong IAM with individual accounts and least privilege. Enforce MFA and just-in-time access. Implement network access controls with VPC, NACLs, and VPN. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager and establish governance with AWS Organizations and Config.

choices.title: Record operator sessions and retain logs

helpfulResource.displayText: Implement session recording and log retention to maintain accountability, support security investigations, and meet regulatory requirements. This practice provides visibility into infrastructure changes and audit trails for operational activities.

improvementPlan.displayText: Enable AWS CloudTrail across regions and accounts with log file validation and encryption. Implement session logging through AWS Systems Manager. Set up Amazon CloudWatch Logs with retention periods. Establish log storage strategy with lifecycle policies and configure monitoring and alerting.

helpfulResource.displayText: Empowering regional teams while maintaining organizational consistency requires a balanced approach that combines clear governance frameworks with operational autonomy.

improvementPlan.displayText: Establish regional authority structure with AWS Organizations. Configure regional access controls with region-specific IAM roles. Deploy regional operations framework with local monitoring and incident response. Enable knowledge sharing and implement regional compliance controls.

questions.title: How do you apply data sovereignty requirements?
questions.description: Data sovereignty requirements are spread over multiple frameworks, industry-specific regulations, sovereign legislations, and local government policies. These requirements are jurisdiction-specific and range from residency and handling restrictions to using specialized protection measures.

helpfulResource.displayText: Data sovereignty attributes are typically derived from storage, processing, retention, handling, geo-location, transmission and access control requirements. Attach these attributes as metadata to datasets for policy as code enforcement and fine-grained access controls.

improvementPlan.displayText: Set up a data classification model aligned with jurisdiction requirements. Map classification levels to sovereignty attributes. Automatically trigger classification using EventBridge. Deploy modular classification with Amazon Macie, AWS Glue, and Amazon Comprehend. Enable monitoring with Security Hub.

questions.title: How do you apply verifiable controls over sensitive data?
questions.description: Having verifiable controls and comprehensive visibility over sensitive data provides tangible evidence that security measures are in place. This includes implementing data sovereignty controls, privacy-enhancing technologies, and data lineage tracking.

choices.title: Establish data sovereignty controls aligning with regional data residency requirements

helpfulResource.displayText: In highly regulated industries, you need to implement data sovereignty controls. These are controls designed to meet requirements related to data residency, access restrictions, and regulatory adherence.

improvementPlan.displayText: Understand data residency needs including adequacy arrangements. Establish organizational level controls using AWS Control Tower with Region deny and data residency controls. Deploy workload-specific preventative and detective controls. Implement key management restrictions and choose appropriate AWS infrastructure.

choices.title: Provide technical options to enhance privacy

helpfulResource.displayText: Digital sovereignty requirements demand that organizations secure data and provide verifiable evidence of privacy protection measures. Technical privacy enhancement options enable processing sensitive data while minimizing exposure risks.

improvementPlan.displayText: Assess data sensitivity and privacy requirements. Implement encryption and key management with KMS, CloudHSM, and External Key Stores. Deploy tokenization, masking, and privacy enhancements. Establish confidential computing environments with Nitro Enclaves and privacy vaults. Implement data minimization strategies.

helpfulResource.displayText: Organizations in highly regulated industries must implement data lineage tracking. Data lineage provides critical transparency for regulatory adherence, impact analysis, and data governance by documenting the complete journey of data from source to consumption.

improvementPlan.displayText: Assess current data landscape and lineage requirements. Document data classification levels and associated lineage requirements. Deploy Amazon DataZone for centralized data governance with OpenLineage-compatible lineage capture and visualization capabilities.

questions.title: How do you fulfil specialised data protection requirements?
questions.description: Customers operating in highly-regulated industries are often subject to specialised data protection requirements. These range from using approved encryption algorithms and devices to pre-certified confidential compute environments that protect data during processing.

helpfulResource.displayText: If you hold sensitive datasets, you might require air-gapped confidential compute environments for processing. This is in addition to at-rest and in-transit encryption.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use confidential compute with AWS Nitro System. Isolate and offload compute to Nitro Enclaves. Use EC2 Dedicated Hosts for dedicated hardware isolation. Enable memory encryption on supported instance types. Apply secure key management practices with AWS KMS.

helpfulResource.displayText: You may have specific requirements to ring-fence cryptographic operations to within specific infrastructure locations. By constructing boundaries around cryptographic operations, you can protect both your data and cryptographic keys.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use AWS KMS Regional keys appropriately. Consider AWS KMS External Key Store or AWS CloudHSM integration for strict sovereignty requirements. Restrict access to keys and actions using IAM policies. Record and control encryption context for auditing.

questions.title: How do you plan for survivability?
questions.description: Comprehensive survivability planning addresses cyber attacks, natural disasters, and infrastructure failures while maintaining regulatory adherence. This planning is fundamental to customer trust, meeting service level agreements, and verifying long-term organizational viability.

choices.title: Document and rank critical business continuity risks

helpfulResource.displayText: Documenting and ranking critical business continuity risks enables proactive identification of potential service disruptions and effective resource allocation. You should also consider compliance obligations while ranking risks.

improvementPlan.displayText: Identify and document technical, operational, and compliance risks. Prioritize risks by likelihood and impact. Build mitigation strategies with preventive, detective, and remediation controls. Track risks using centralized tools and create recovery procedures.

choices.title: Develop mitigation plans for critical risks

helpfulResource.displayText: Proactive risk management is essential for maintaining business continuity, regulatory adherence, and stakeholder trust. You need a structured approach to manage critical risks including robust mitigation plans.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use AWS Audit Manager to discover reliability risks and mitigations. Use AWS Systems Manager Application Manager for application views. Use AWS Resilience Hub to define resilience goals. Map dependencies with AWS X-Ray. Implement compliance controls with AWS Control Tower.

helpfulResource.displayText: Document your disaster recovery procedures to enable operations to recover quickly while maintaining your regulatory posture. Include steps to recover critical systems, meet recovery timelines, and establish clear accountability.

improvementPlan.displayText: Define recovery objectives using AWS Resilience Hub. Create system inventory with AWS Systems Manager and resource groups. Establish recovery team structure. Implement infrastructure as code with CloudFormation and CDK. Document procedures in Systems Manager and configure backup workflows.

helpfulResource.displayText: Select and set up recovery sites that meet your data and operational sovereignty requirements, especially if you operate in regulated industries. Recovery plans should maintain data and workloads in approved locations.

improvementPlan.displayText: Assess regulatory requirements and document data protection needs. Select and validate AWS Regions for recovery. Configure encryption and key management with AWS KMS and CloudHSM. Design recovery network using VPC, Transit Gateway, and Direct Connect. Automate recovery infrastructure with IaC.

helpfulResource.displayText: Organizations in highly regulated industries must establish independent localized operations across different geographical regions to maintain adherence to data sovereignty requirements and regulatory mandates specific to each jurisdiction.

improvementPlan.displayText: Develop regulatory assessment framework for each Region. Configure AWS Organizations with Region-specific OUs and service control policies. Implement multi-account structure for each Region. Define encryption strategy with AWS KMS and CloudHSM. Design network architecture for regional segmentation.

choices.title: Train team members on recovery procedures

helpfulResource.displayText: In regulated industries, training on recovery procedures is essential for maintaining regulatory adherence, minimizing incident impact, and protecting against financial and reputational damage. Well-trained teams can execute recovery plans effectively under pressure.

improvementPlan.displayText: Define training program structure with role-based curricula using AWS Skill Builder. Define recovery roles and procedures with validation checks. Set up simulation environments using AWS Resilience Hub and AWS Fault Injection Service for regular testing.

choices.title: Create manual backup plans for system outages

helpfulResource.displayText: In highly regulated industries, manual contingency plans are essential for maintaining business continuity and regulatory compliance when primary systems fail. These plans serve as critical fallback procedures.

improvementPlan.displayText: Identify and document critical systems using AWS Systems Manager and Resource Groups. Define recovery objectives per system. Map dependencies using Service Catalog and AWS Config. Develop role-based procedures. Configure monitoring with CloudWatch. Implement documentation management system.

questions.title: How do you optimize for performance without compromising on sovereignty?
questions.description: Optimizing performance without compromising sovereignty is essential for organizations. This practice maintains legal adherence to data protection regulations and provides national security and strategic independence while preserving business continuity.

choices.title: Implement optimal traffic routing aligning with regulatory needs

helpfulResource.displayText: Maintaining data sovereignty and jurisdictional adherence is crucial in highly regulated industries. Improper traffic routing can result in legal penalties and security risks. Organizations must implement strategic routing mechanisms that respect geographic boundaries.

improvementPlan.displayText: Document data classification requirements and map compliance needs. Configure Amazon Route 53 with health checks, latency-based routing, and geolocation rules. choices.title: Optimize applications while maintaining data sovereignty

helpfulResource.displayText: Maintaining data sovereignty while optimizing application performance is crucial for compliance and operational efficiency. By minimizing external data transfers and processing data within the cloud, organizations can reduce their compliance footprint.

improvementPlan.displayText: Deploy comprehensive caching using ElastiCache and DynamoDB Accelerator within VPC private subnets. Implement PrivateLink with VPC endpoints.

questions.title: How do you choose optimal compute solutions without compromising on sovereignty?
questions.description: Customers must balance between using modern computing capabilities and adhering to regulatory requirements. This includes data protection laws and national security policies. Choosing optimal compute solutions improves adherence while maintaining performance and operational efficiency.

choices.title: Implement confidential computing technologies for data protection during processing

helpfulResource.displayText: Confidential computing technology extends traditional security models for highly regulated industries. It protects sensitive data not just at rest and in transit, but also during processing by using hardware-enforced isolated runtime environments.

improvementPlan.displayText: Catalog sensitive data workflows and identify workloads requiring data-in-use protection. Select EC2 instance types supporting AWS Nitro Enclaves with VPC network segmentation. Configure AWS KMS with enclave-specific policies and CloudHSM. Build Nitro Enclaves images with attestation. choices.title: Maintain sovereign control over encryption keys

helpfulResource.displayText: Sovereign key management provides organizations full control over their encryption keys, aligning with national data residency and sovereignty laws. This blocks third-party access to sensitive data and reduces legal risks.

improvementPlan.displayText: Document regulatory and compliance requirements for key sovereignty. Deploy AWS CloudHSM clusters in compliant regions and integrate with AWS KMS using External Key Store or custom key stores. Configure automated key rotation with lifecycle management and strict IAM policies. Enable CloudTrail and CloudWatch for audit logging and compliance validation.

choices.title: Validate open-source components for sovereignty compliance

helpfulResource.displayText: Open-source solutions can provide essential transparency for demonstrating compliance and managing risk. However, they require rigorous validation to verify they meet regulatory requirements and security standards.

questions.title: How do you consider sovereignty requirements when designing networks?
questions.description: Network architectures must account for data residency restrictions and traffic routing constraints. choices.title: Choose open protocols and approved encryption schemes

helpfulResource.displayText: Using open protocols and approved encryption schemes improves your adherence to national cybersecurity standards and industry regulations. This also avoids vendor lock-in and supply-chain bottlenecks.

improvementPlan.displayText: Conduct inventory assessment documenting current cryptography and certificate management. Implement cryptographic standards configuring AWS KMS for FIPS 140-2 compliance. helpfulResource.displayText: In highly regulated industries, maintaining integrity of network infrastructure configurations through comprehensive verification processes is crucial for security, compliance, and operational stability.
